paint.shared.objects

Class Track

  • java.lang.Object
    • paint.shared.objects.Track

  • public class Track
extends Object
    Represents a single molecular trajectory extracted from a PAINT recording.

    Tracks contain both raw geometric motion information and higher-level analytics computed from those motions.
